sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "speakers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_named_by_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_named_by_user" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "centroid" BLOB NULL, "embedding_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "profile_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("profile_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "voice_device" TEXT NULL, "low_confidence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("low_confidence" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meetings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "audio_path" TEXT NULL, "minutes_json" TEXT NULL, "error_message" TEXT NULL, "agenda" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "expected_attendees" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "context_notes" TEXT NULL, "template" TEXT NULL, "input_device" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "segments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "meeting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "idx" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "text" TEXT NOT NULL, "speaker_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES speakers (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "embedding" BLOB NULL, "speaker_locked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("speaker_locked" IN (0, 1)), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'speech', "asr_confidence" REAL NULL, "speaker_confidence" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "glossary_terms" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "term" TEXT NOT NULL, "ar_spelling" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "meeting_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "task" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_speaker_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES speakers (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "owner_text" TEXT NULL, "due_text" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "source_meeting_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "evidence_segment_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_updates_pending" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "meeting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "new_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "evidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "speaker_profiles" ("speaker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES speakers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "profile_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "evidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("speaker_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "speaker_meeting_notes" ("speaker_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES speakers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "meeting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "notes_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("speaker_id", "meeting_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "code_findings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "meeting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "speaker_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES speakers (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "segment_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_dismissals" ("meeting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("meeting_id", "kind", "item_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "official_records" ("meeting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "entity_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "committee" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "number_year" INTEGER NULL, "meeting_number" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "record_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("meeting_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "minutes_versions" ("meeting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "minutes_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "approved_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("meeting_id", "version"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "minutes_signatures" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "meeting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "signer_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "signer_role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "strokes_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "signed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX segments_meeting_idx ON segments (meeting_id, idx)
CREATE INDEX segments_speaker ON segments (speaker_id)
CREATE INDEX glossary_terms_meeting ON glossary_terms (meeting_id)
CREATE INDEX tasks_status ON tasks (status)
CREATE INDEX tasks_source_meeting ON tasks (source_meeting_id)
CREATE INDEX task_updates_pending_meeting ON task_updates_pending (meeting_id)
CREATE INDEX task_updates_pending_task ON task_updates_pending (task_id)
CREATE INDEX speaker_meeting_notes_meeting ON speaker_meeting_notes (meeting_id)
CREATE INDEX code_findings_meeting ON code_findings (meeting_id)
CREATE INDEX official_records_sequence ON official_records (entity_key, committee, number_year)
CREATE INDEX minutes_signatures_meeting ON minutes_signatures (meeting_id)
